deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Hotfix candidate ready for expedited deploy: rwd-inference/model-serving@v2.14.3 -> production. Reason: kv-cache drop on long-tail requests (errors ~2.7% today). Requesting ops approval window 00:30-01:00 UTC.

marta: Looking at the metrics — agree we should fast-track. Can we pin to v2.14.3+patch-01 so rollback is trivial?

sam_k: +1 for pin. Also want a short rollback plan in thread: immediate image rollback + traffic-pin to stable pool if errors spike.

leo_t: ops question: do we need a canary? If we skip canary, we should have kill-switch and runbook ready.

ops-oncall: I can be on-call for the window. If we skip canary, require deploybot escrow and manual rollback trigger (\`/deploy rollback\`). I need a signed-off release note line and list of dashboards to watch.

marta: Release note draft: "Hotfix: kv-cache stability for long sequences; fixes intermittent OOM and 503s. Rollback: revert to v2.14.2 image. Impact: ~2.7% error rate on long requests; fix expected to reduce to <0.1%." Thoughts?

devex-ember: +1 release note. Add mention of customer-facing impact: embeddings and large-chat sessions.

sam_k: ops-oncall do you want a short list: latency_p50, kv_cache_misses, gen_errors_5m, gpu_mem_pressure?

ops-oncall: yes. Also enable extended logs for model-serving on 2x retention for the window. I'll attach retention toggle.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Approval checklist: 1) Build artifact available (sha: a1b2c3d) 2) Image pinned to tag v2.14.3-p01 3) Ops oncall present 4) Release note posted 5) Rollback command tested. Current status: items 1-2-3-4: true. 5: pending.

marta: Sam can you run the rollback test now? Keep it non-disruptive (dry-run).

sam_k: Running rollback dry-run: command used:
```
/ops rollback --service model-serving --to v2.14.2 --dry-run
```
Dry-run passed, no config drift. Ready to proceed.

ops-oncall: With that I'm comfortable. Approving expedited deploy for 00:30-01:00 UTC. Will watch gen_errors_5m and kv_cache_misses. If gen_errors_5m > 1% for 3 consecutive mins, I trigger rollback.

marta: @deploy-bot please proceed with deploy at 00:30 UTC, skip canary per agreement. Tagging release note in #release-notes afterwards.

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] Executing: deploy --service model-serving --image rwd-inference/model-serving:v2.14.3-p01 --strategy immediate --skip-canary --tag "hotfix-kvcache-1759123456"

sam_k: Leaving a final checklist: post-deploy smoke (ok), trace-sample check (ok), customer-facing monitor (ok). Will update thread with final status.

ops-oncall: ACK. Will keep this thread pinned and escalate to sec if anything abnormal. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks team — aiming for minimal blast radius.
